description: check_name_constraints unconditionally constructs GeneralName::DirectoryName(cert.subject) and checks it against permitted DN subtrees, even when subject is an empty sequence (0 RDNs). If nc_constrained_types includes NC_TYPE_DIRECTORY_NAME, an empty subject matches no non-empty permitted DN subtree → NameConstraintViolation is returned. RFC 5280 §4.2.1.6 requires empty-subject certs to have a critical SAN; the NC check should skip the subject DN and only check the SAN names. → A valid SAN-only certificate issued through a NC-constrained CA would be incorrectly rejected.
title: Empty subject DN fails DN permitted-subtrees check: false rejection for SAN-only certs
